prompt.unusual_lang_file_name:
=== UNUSUAL FILE NAME FOR A LOCALIZATION FILE ===
The selected file is named '{file}', but Localization (lang) files are usually named <language code>.json (like en.json, or pt-BR.json).
Are you sure that this is a Localization file and not a Babele file?
[{yes}] Yes, continue anyway.
[{no}] No, abort.
prompt.discard_progress:
=== SETTINGS CHANGED SINCE THE LAST RUN ===
These settings differ from those of the existing progress for this input file:
{changes}
They cannot be applied to a process that is already under way.
[{yes}] Discard the existing progress and start fresh with the current settings.
[{no}] No, keep the progress (restore the previous settings yourself, then prepare again).
prompt.batch_nonfatal_errors:
Batch {batch}/{batches} contains {count} placeholder translation error(s).
Click '{show_log}' to investigate the details.

prompt.overwrite_terminology:
=== EXISTING TERMINOLOGY FILE WILL BE OVERWRITTEN ===
There is already a terminology file for this input:
{file}
It will be replaced by a freshly built terminology.
Any changes you might have made to it manually will be lost!
If you consider it final, save it in another location before proceeding.
[{yes}] Yes, overwrite it.
[{no}] No, abort (so you can move the file first).

tooltip.input_file: Pick the file to translate: a Babele JSON export or a Foundry localization file (lang/*.json).
tooltip.output_folder: Where the translated file and the review items are written. Default: your user data folder.
tooltip.reset_output_folder: Back to the default output folder.
tooltip.input_type: What kind of file you are translating. Changes how texts are extracted and the output is named.
tooltip.language: Source and target language of the translation.
tooltip.flavour: Game system and genre. They steer terminology and style of the AI translation.
tooltip.module_name: Used to name the output folder and files. Derived from the input file and/or its path. Edit as needed. Best practice: Name it exactly after the module-id of the source Foundry VTT mod.
tooltip.max_batch_size: Maximum characters per single AI request. Larger batches need fewer requests, but can fail if they exceed limits. Smaller batches are more failsafe (less retries), but may cause overhead and increase total processing time.
tooltip.review_terminology: Stops after the terminology is complete, so you can review and edit it as needed. Then click Start to continue. Option is recommended for each new input file, and auto-disables itself after each run.
tooltip.simulate_only: Simulates all AI requests without costs. Nothing real is translated, and progress is kept separate from real runs.
tooltip.prepare: Analyzes the input file and builds the batches. Nothing is sent to the AI yet.
tooltip.cancel: Completes the current batch, then stops. Progress is kept, so you can resume later.
tooltip.waiting: Waiting for the current batch to complete. Then the run stops.
tooltip.reconfigure: Back to the settings. Existing progress is kept.
tooltip.clear_terminology: Discards the terminology of this input file. It will be rebuilt on next start.
tooltip.clear_translation: Discards all translations of this input file. They will be redone on next start.
tooltip.show_review_items: Opens the list of translation issues you accepted, with the context of each, so that you can fix them later by hand.
tooltip.pop_out_log: Opens the log in its own window, which keeps updating during the run.
